title: Electron development profile and live UI
description: Build package:mac and package:mac:dev first. Uses its own profile and ports 5186/9513/9514. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN for an existing gateway. Only reads gateway state; no dispatch or inference.

live-ui.intent: Save a real gateway login through desktop settings, read fleet.status, observe a source edit reload through Vite, reject remote source configuration, verify the Dev link scheme and gateway-derived Dock badge, relaunch with saved credentials, stop Vite and recover through bundled settings, then retry the live UI. Verify production keeps separate login settings and rejects Development UI.
